summary: The school district argues that preserving the core E-Rate program and maintaining eligibility for various services is crucial for ensuring affordable connectivity and maintaining educational quality. They emphasize the importance of preserving the current eligibility for services such as special construction, dark fiber, self-provisioned networks, and specific network services, and advocate for changes to the discount methodology and screen-time policies to ensure they are fair and practical. Works are actually used for instruction, operations, and student support. Bedford Public Schools urges the FCC to preserve the core strengths of E-Rate, including support for affordable broadband, Internet access, internal connections, Wi-Fi, maintenance, and cost-effective network solutions.
